newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: Emperor says unlikely to reach gold target.
newsitem.headline: Emperor says unlikely to reach gold target.

text.p: Emperor Mines Ltd said on Wednesday its Vatukoula mine in Fiji was unlikely to meet its forecasted gold production of 140,000 ounces in 1997/98 (July-June) because of technical problems.

"Despite a record 140,000 tonnes of ore being treated in April and May at the Vatukoula mine, performances have been affected by problems associated with the new crushing circuit, which will impact on Emperor achieving its production of 140,000 ounces for the financial year," Emperor said in a company newletter.
Ore grade at the mine has been 1.3 grams per tonne lower than forecast for the June quarter to date, with a consequential reduction in recovery of 2.5 percent, Emperor said.
However, gold production for the June quarter is likely to be in line with existing average quarterly figures, the company said.
Last February, Emperor warned it might not meet forecast annual production due to necessary maintenance work at the mine.
